title: A graded vector space with a left dual is finite dimensional and the evaluation is a perfect pairing
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a graded vector space admitting a left dual in the monoidal category of graded vector spaces has finite total dimension and that the evaluation gives nondegenerate pairings between opposite graded pieces (statement lines 4280-4288). The proof is a complete argument: the unit is identified with the field in degree 0 so that the evaluation becomes a family of pairings (proof lines 4290-4296); the first triangle identity expresses the identity on W through a finite sum and hence shows that W is generated by finitely many vectors, which gives finiteness of the total dimension of V (proof lines 4297-4307); the second triangle identity evaluated on basis vectors produces the dual-basis relation and hence nondegeneracy (proof lines 4308-4323). The non-formal content is the extraction of the dual basis from the two identities. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
